sentences.en: A In 1942 Allan R Holmberg, a doctoral student in anthropology from Yale University, USA, ventured deep into the jungle of Bolivian Amazonia and searched out an isolated band of Siriono Indians.
sentences.zh: 1942年,美国耶鲁大学人类学博士生艾伦·霍尔姆伯格潜入玻利维亚亚马逊河流域丛林,搜查了一群孤立的锡里昂诺印第安人。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: The Siriono, Holmberg later wrote, led a “strikingly backward” existence.
sentences.zh: 希里奥诺,霍尔姆伯格后来写道,导致“渐渐倒退”的存在。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: Their villages were little more than clusters of thatched huts.
sentences.zh: 他们的村庄几乎只是几群破棚屋。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: Life itself was a perpetual and punishing search for food: some families grew manioc and other starchy crops in small garden plots cleared from the forest, while other members of the tribe scoured the country for small game and promising fish holes.
sentences.zh: 生活本身就是一场永恒的、惩罚性的寻找食物的追求:一些家庭在森林中清除的小园地种植木薯和其他恒星作物,而其他部落成员则为小游戏和有希望的鱼洞而在该国游荡。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系。

sentences.en: When local resources became depleted, the tribe moved on.
sentences.zh: 当当地资源枯竭时,部落便继续前进。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系。

sentences.en: As for technology, Holmberg noted, the Siriono “may be classified among the most handicapped people of the world”.
sentences.zh: 关于技术,霍尔姆贝格指出,锡里昂诺“可能属于世界上最残疾人之列”。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

sentences.en: Other than bows, arrows and crude digging sticks, the only tools the Siriono seemed to possess were “two machetes worn to the size of pocketknives”.
sentences.zh: 除了弓、箭和粗糙的挖土棒之外,Siliono似乎拥有的唯一工具是“两把刀,尺寸与袖口刀一样大”。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: B Although the lives of the Siriono have changed in the intervening decades, the image of them as Stone Age relics has endured.
sentences.zh: 虽然在其后几十年里,Siriono人的生活发生了变化,但他们作为石器时代遗迹的形象却一直受到考验。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系。

sentences.en: Indeed, in many respects the Siriono epitomize the popular conception of life in Amazonia.
sentences.zh: 事实上,在许多方面,Siriono是亚马逊河流域流行的生活概念的缩影。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: To casual observers, as well as to influential natural scientists and regional planners, the luxuriant forests of Amazonia seem ageless, unconquerable, a habitat totally hostile to human civilization.
sentences.zh: 对于临时观察员以及有影响力的自然科学家和区域规划者来说,亚马逊河流域的奢侈森林似乎没有年龄、无法征服,是完全敌视人类文明的生境。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: The apparent simplicity of Indian ways of life has been judged an evolutionary adaptation to forest ecology, living proof that Amazonia could not – and cannot – sustain a more complex society.
sentences.zh: 印度生活方式的简单性显然被认为是对森林生态的进化适应,这活生生地证明亚马逊无法 — — 也不能 — — 维持一个更复杂的社会。

grammar.type: 被动语态 + 分词结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者；分词短语压缩了背景或附加动作。

sentences.en: Archaeological traces of far more elaborate cultures have been dismissed as the ruins of invaders from outside the region, abandoned to decay in the uncompromising tropical environment.
sentences.zh: 考古上更精密文化的痕迹被排除,因为该区域外的入侵者废墟被弃置,在不妥协的热带环境中腐烂。

grammar.type: 被动语态 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: C The popular conception of Amazonia and its native residents would be enormously consequential if it were true.
sentences.zh: 亚马逊河流域及其当地居民的流行概念如果是真实的,将会产生巨大影响。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系。

sentences.en: But the human history of Amazonia in the past 11,000 years betrays that view as myth.
sentences.zh: 但亚马逊人的历史在过去11000年中背叛了这个神话

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: Evidence gathered in recent years from anthropology and archaeology indicates that the region has supported a series of indigenous cultures for eleven thousand years; an extensive network of complex societies – some with populations perhaps as large as 100,000 – thrived there for more than 1,000 years before the arrival of Europeans.
sentences.zh: 近年来从人类学和考古学中收集的证据表明,该地区支持一系列土著文化已有11 000年;一个广泛的复杂社会网络 — — 有些拥有10万人口 — — 在欧洲人到达之前已经发展了1000多年。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: (Indeed, some contemporary tribes, including the Siriono, still live among the earthworks of earlier cultures.)
sentences.zh: (事实上,一些当代部落,包括锡里昂诺部落,仍然生活在古代文化的土木中。 )

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；分词短语压缩了背景或附加动作。

sentences.en: Far from being evolutionarily retarded, prehistoric Amazonian people developed technologies and cultures that were advanced for their time.
sentences.zh: 亚马逊史前人远非是进化迟钝的,而是发展了他们时代先进的技术和文化。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

sentences.en: If the lives of Indians today seem “primitive”, the appearance is not the result of some environmental adaptation or ecological barrier; rather it is a comparatively recent adaptation to centuries of economic and political pressure.
sentences.zh: 如果说今天印度人的生活看起来“原始”,那么,其外观并不是某些环境适应或生态障碍的结果,而是相对近期适应数世纪经济和政治压力的结果。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词。

sentences.en: D The evidence for a revised view of Amazonia will take many people by surprise.
sentences.zh: 亚马逊河流域的改变观点的证据将给许多人带来惊喜

sentences.en: Ecologists have assumed that tropical ecosystems were shaped entirely by natural forces and they have focused their research on habitats they believe have escaped human influence.
sentences.zh: 生态学家们认为热带生态系统完全是由自然力量形成的,他们的研究重点是他们认为逃避人类影响的生境。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

sentences.en: But as the University of Florida ecologist, Peter Feinsinger, has noted, an approach that leaves people out of the equation is no longer tenable.
sentences.zh: 但正如佛罗里达大学生态学家彼得·费辛杰所指出的, 一种让人置身于方程式之外的做法已经无法忍受了。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: The archaeological evidence shows that the natural history of Amazonia is to a surprising extent tied to the activities of its prehistoric inhabitants.
sentences.zh: 考古证据表明,亚马逊的自然历史与亚马逊史前居民的活动有惊人的联系。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: E The realization comes none too soon.
sentences.zh: E的实现不会太早。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: In June 1992 political and environmental leaders from across the world met in Rio de Janeiro to discuss how developing countries can advance their economies without destroying their natural resources.
sentences.zh: 1992年6月,世界各地的政治和环境领导人在里约热内卢举行会议,讨论发展中国家如何在不破坏其自然资源的情况下推进其经济。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: The challenge is especially difficult in Amazonia.
sentences.zh: 在亚马逊地区,挑战尤其艰巨。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: Because the tropical forest has been depicted as ecologically unfit for large-scale human occupation, some environmentalists have opposed development of any kind.
sentences.zh: 由于热带森林被描述为生态上不适合大规模人类占领,一些环境学家反对任何形式的发展。

grammar.type: 被动语态 + 状语从句
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系。

sentences.en: Ironically, one major casualty of that extreme position has been the environment itself.
sentences.zh: 具有讽刺意味的是,这一极端状况的一个主要受害者是环境本身。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: While policy makers struggle to define and implement appropriate legislation, development of the most destructive kind has continued apace over vast areas.
sentences.zh: 在决策者努力制定和执行适当立法的同时,破坏力最大的一类立法的发展在广大地区继续迅速发展。

grammar.type: 状语从句 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: F The other major casualty of the “naturalism” of environmental scientists has been the indigenous Amazonians, whose habits of hunting, fishing, and slash-and-burn cultivation often have been represented as harmful to the habitat.
sentences.zh: F 环境科学家的“自然”造成其他主要伤亡的是土著亚马孙人,他们狩猎、捕鱼和砍刀烧火的耕作习惯往往被说成是对生境有害的。

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 被动语态
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

sentences.en: In the clash between environmentalists and developers, the Indians, whose presence is in fact crucial to the survival of the forest, have suffered the most.
sentences.zh: 在环境保护主义者和开发者之间的冲突中,印第安人遭受的痛苦最大,他们的存在事实上对森林的生存至关重要。

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: The new understanding of the pre-history of Amazonia, however, points toward a middle ground.
sentences.zh: 然而,对亚马逊史前历史的新理解却指向了中间立场。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: Archaeology makes clear that with judicious management selected parts of the region could support more people than anyone thought before.
sentences.zh: 考古学清楚地表明,如果明智地管理,本区域某些部分能够比以前任何人想象的多支持更多的人。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: The longburied past, it seems, offers hope for the future.
sentences.zh: 长久沉浸的过去似乎为未来带来了希望。
